ico.note: ICO publishes origin and quality groups, not individual origins or marks. A group indicator is not the FOB price quoted against the C contract for a named lot, and no certification breakdown is published.

differentials.note: OPTIONAL OVERRIDE — normally empty. The ICO Coffee Market Report is now fetched and parsed every run, and supplies group indicator prices, the differentials between those groups, and certified stocks. This file exists only for figures held in a document the pipeline cannot reach. PRIVATE DATA WARNING: this repository is public. Broker differentials and trader circulars are proprietary, and committing them here makes them world-readable and permanent in git history. Keep this file to figures you are content to publish, or move the site to a private repo on a paid plan first.

certifiedStocks.note: OPTIONAL OVERRIDE — normally empty. Certified stocks now come from the ICO Coffee Market Report, which publishes a monthly figure for the New York and London markets. ICE's own daily report remains behind bot protection, and every free API found for it was a paid reseller. PRIVATE DATA WARNING: this repository is public — do not commit figures you are not content to publish, and never paste broker or trader material here.
